current.text: He is a rookie. Charlotte drafted him 18th overall in the 2026 NBA Draft.
Coby White is Charlotte's starting guard, so Anderson is not expected to start.
He is not yet trusted as Charlotte's backup point guard. The team has no trusted backup point guard on the roster.
Walker calls him a fun archetype rather than a functional player for now.
His Summer League was disappointing because of bad shooting, but he took a high volume of threes.
One dynasty ranker puts him 16th in the rookie class and really likes him, but says he will not start this season.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with an ankle injury.
Charlotte plans to space the floor and take a lot of threes. Playmaking will be spread across several players instead of one main creator.
Charlotte has a deep roster. Schröder and Allen are also on the guard bench.
Coby White is out with a calf injury and will probably miss the start of the season.
Charlotte has only 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum. Its playoff schedule for a March 28 end is 4-3-4 games.

durable.text: Experts rate him as possibly the best passer and the best shooter in the 2026 draft class. One speaker says he has two outlier skills and rates him above consensus.
He is undersized for a guard.
His size and defense are the main concerns about his game.
